data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that allows listening to multiple ValueListenables simultaneously.
data.what_it_does: It provides a single widget, MultiValueListenableBuilder, which accepts a list of ValueListenables and a builder callback. When any of the provided listenables change, the builder triggers a rebuild with the updated values.
use_when: You need to rebuild a widget when any of multiple ValueListenables changes
You want to avoid deeply nesting multiple ValueListenableBuilders
avoid_when: You are using a heavy state management solution like BLoC, Riverpod, or Provider that already handles multiple values
You only need to listen to a single ValueListenable
strengths: Simplifies code by eliminating nested ValueListenableBuilders
Lightweight with no external dependencies other than Flutter
weaknesses: Does not provide complex state management features or business logic patterns
